title: MSFS 2024: marketplace update! City overhauls & the hardest landing?
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just received another expansion, and this week it's all about urban exploration and high-stakes aviation. We’re moving beyond default photogrammetry to test hand-crafted cityscapes and some of the world's most challenging approaches.

In this video, we dive into:

- Cityscape Overhauls: Side-by-side comparisons of Istanbul, Bratislava, and Albuquerque from ACscenery. Does the hand-crafted detail beat the default 2024 streaming data?
- Modern Gateways: A close look at Paro International (VQPR) in Bhutan—one of the most dangerous airports in the world—and the new Tulum International "Jungle Airport."
- 1935 Historical Series: We step back in time at Schiphol, Friedrichshafen, and London Croydon to see how Redwing is recreating the golden age of flight.
